authorityBoundary: EveTui owns compact terminal/grid projection, keyboard command input, dense state inspection, terminal capability manifests, capture transcripts, and TUI-specific style/token lowering. Providers such as Aetheria own live state, authored TUI surfaces, command authorization, receipts, and product-specific flows. Eve keeps the GUI/TUI surface contracts, command descriptors, provider advertisements, plugin advertisements, and conformance export contracts.

moveSets.replacementProof: EveTui hosts a provider-agnostic TUI lowerer that consumes provider advertisements and Eve surface documents without importing provider internals.
EveTui claims the provider-advertised tui world-surface lowering target with explicit support level, lossiness, command boundary, and transcript evidence.
TUI actions emit gamecult.eve.command.v1 intents through provider-advertised command boundaries and render provider receipts instead of mutating local state.
EveTui attaches deterministic terminal transcript or cell-grid capture artifacts to conformance output.
